info.name: Spaceship.com Async Operations Domain Transfer API
Get the details of the domain transfer

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose transfer details are to be returned.

items.docs: Get the details of the ongoing domain transfer. ### Required Permissions - domains:transfer ### Rate Limits * The limit for requesting transfer info is 5 requests per domain, within 300 seconds.
Requests domain transfer. ### Required Permissions - domains:billing ### Rate Limits * The limit to transfer domains is 30 requests per user, within 30 seconds.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose auth code is to be returned.

items.docs: Get the domain's auth code, also known as EPP code, authorization code, transfer code or Auth-Info Code. ### Required Permissions - domains:transfer ### Rate Limits * The limit for obtaining auth codes is 5 requests per domain, within 300 seconds.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain whose transfer lock is being updated.

items.docs: Allows the modification of a domain transfer lock. ### Required Permissions - domains:transfer ### Rate Limits * The limit for updating the transfer lock for a domain is 5 requests per domain within 300 seconds.
